# Award-Winning Salesforce AppExchange Partner

Centralize, verify, and monitor provider credentials directly in Salesforce with a native application, primary source integrations and automated NCQA-compliant workflows.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/6980e577c80ab1fdf08a4e67_cvo-bg-gradient.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff3882aa8be4e3832012_salesforce-hero-img.avif)

## A Single Source of Truth for Provider Data & Teams

Whether it's a need to unify data and teams in one system for greater visibility, improve efficiency, or create better experiences, healthcare organizations can overcome common provider operations challenges with a single source of truth on Salesforce. As a pre-built native Salesforce application, Verifiable helps you achieve proven faster time to value by extending the Salesforce platform with data model, integrations, workflows, and self-serve insights needed for scalability, quality, and compliance.

By managing provider data in Salesforce, with Verifiable as your credentialing technology provider you get:

[**Unified Operations**](https://verifiable.com/salesforce-credentialing-network-monitoring#)

Connect credentialing status directly to Contracting (Health Cloud), Onboarding (Service Cloud), and claims payments.

### Real-Time Data Sync

When a license is verified or updated, the change is reflected instantly across the organization—preventing the finance team from paying a provider with a lapsed credential. 360-Degree Provider View: See enrollment status, privileges, and compliance history all on one dashboard.

## How Salesforce And Verfiable Are Scaling Provider Networks With Automation

Managing provider networks has never been more complex. Between growing compliance requirements (NCQA, Federal and State Regulations), rising provider expectations, and the challenge of fragmented systems, health plans are under pressure to ensure data is accurate, complete, and scalable.

In a recent webinar, leaders from Salesforce, Verifiable, and Excellus BCBS shared how automation and strong data infrastructure are helping health plans modernize credentialing and overall provider network management.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff37a9d14bbb7aaee030_recap-img.avif)

[View the Webinar](https://verifiable.com/blog/how-salesforce-verifiable-and-excellus-bcbs-are-scaling-provider-networks-with-automation)

## Powers Your Provider Credentialing.   Salesforce Aligns Your Provider Data.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff36c11837e13bdf25a3_salesforce-cloud.svg)

CredAgent® acts as an autonomous extension of your team, clearing backlogs and accelerating turnaround times without sacrificing governance.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff3687c12b1e93dd1d13_batch-icon.svg)

### Batch Processing in the Cloud

CredAgent processes thousands of verifications in parallel and syncs the results instantly to the Provider Record in Salesforce.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff359a7b71f2eea50223_full-icon.svg)

### Full Transparency

View decision logs, cited primary sources, and verification screenshots directly within the Salesforce object. You get 10x speed with full auditability.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f274600ac3de0cf25b08be9/698dff35ec803d96bf78b6d3_triggers-icon.svg)

### Automated Task Triggers

When CredAgent detects a risk (e.g., a sanction), it doesn't just send an email—it automatically triggers a Salesforce workflow to flag the record or assign a task to your compliance officer.
